derivations.quote: Write $f=2^{-p}(a+ib)$ and $g=2^{-p}(c+ie)$, where $a,b,c,e$ are integer-coefficient polynomials of degree below $r$ with coefficients of absolute value at most $2^p$. Set $B_0=2^{4p}$, the packing base.
Since $2^{p+1}<B_0-1$, the geometric sum gives $|A_u|\le2^p(B_0^r-1)/(B_0-1)<B_0^r/2$, so it fits in $4pr$ bits.

Signed packing multiplies the four pairs of absolute values with the [Established O(n log n) multiplier](hvdh-multiplier.md), restoring each sign, to obtain $A_aA_c,A_bA_e,A_aA_e,A_bA_c$. For the ordinary product $h=ac$ in $\mathbb Z[y]$, $A_aA_c=(ac)(B_0)=\sum_{j<2r}h_jB_0^j$, padding $h_{2r-1}=0$.
Each $h_j$ sums at most $r$ products of coefficients of size at most $2^p$, so $|h_j|\le r2^{2p}<2^{3p}<B_0/2$.

Since $-B_0<u_j+\gamma_j<B_0$ whenever $\gamma_j\in\{-1,0\}$, the carry stays in $\{-1,0\}$. Telescoping gives $A_u=\sum_{j<r}d_jB_0^j+\gamma_rB_0^r$, so the blocks $d_j$ are a fixed-width two's-complement encoding of $A_u$.

If $\widehat h_i=h_i$ for $i<j$, then $\sum_{i<j}q_iB_0^i=\sum_{i<j}h_iB_0^i+\rho_jB_0^j$, so comparing $Z$ modulo $B_0^{j+1}$ gives $q_j+\rho_j\equiv h_j$ modulo $B_0$. Since $h_j\in[-B_0/2,B_0/2)$, $\widehat h_j=h_j$.
The numerator streams are $ac-be$ (real) and $ae+bc$ (imaginary). Since $y^{j+r}=-y^j$, reduce modulo $y^r+1$ by subtracting the coefficient at $j+r$ from the one at $j$ for $0\le j<r$.
So $H_j$ is a sum of exactly $r$ signed products of coefficients of modulus at most $2^p$, hence $|H_j|\le r2^{2p}$.
Four exact integer products dominate the linear packing, extraction, combination, wrapping and truncation costs, so the total is $O(rp\log(rp))$

relations.quote: It multiplies in the [Polynomial ring modulo y^r + 1](ring-y.md) in $O(rp\log(rp))$ time using only integer multiplication.
Signed packing multiplies the four pairs of absolute values with the [Established O(n log n) multiplier](hvdh-multiplier.md), restoring each sign, to obtain $A_aA_c,A_bA_e,A_aA_e,A_bA_c$.

symbols.name: fractional bits
symbols.meaning: The number of fractional bits of each coefficient component.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ be the number of fractional bits of each coefficient, with $r<2^p$.

symbols.name: ring
symbols.meaning: The ring of polynomials of degree below r modulo y^r+1.
symbols.quote: Let $f,g$ be polynomials of the ring, written $\mathcal R_r$, whose coefficients are $2^{-p}$ times Gaussian integers of modulus at most $2^p$, so coefficients have modulus at most $1$.

symbols.name: first polynomial
symbols.meaning: A polynomial of the ring with coefficients 2^{-p} times Gaussian integers.
symbols.quote: Let $f,g$ be polynomials of the ring, written $\mathcal R_r$, whose coefficients are $2^{-p}$ times Gaussian integers of modulus at most $2^p$, so coefficients have modulus at most $1$.

symbols.name: integer polynomial
symbols.meaning: Integer-coefficient polynomial, real part numerator of f (similarly b, c, e).
symbols.quote: Write $f=2^{-p}(a+ib)$ and $g=2^{-p}(c+ie)$, where $a,b,c,e$ are integer-coefficient polynomials of degree below $r$ with coefficients of absolute value at most $2^p$.

symbols.name: packing base
symbols.meaning: The base 2^{4p} at which polynomials are evaluated.

symbols.name: signed evaluation integer
symbols.meaning: The integer u(B_0) for u among a, b, c, e.
symbols.quote: For $u\in\{a,b,c,e\}$ with coefficients $u_j$, let $A_u=u(B_0)=\sum_{j<r}u_jB_0^j$ be the signed evaluation integer.

symbols.name: coefficient of u
symbols.meaning: The coefficient of y^j in u.
symbols.quote: For $u\in\{a,b,c,e\}$ with coefficients $u_j$, let $A_u=u(B_0)=\sum_{j<r}u_jB_0^j$ be the signed evaluation integer.

symbols.name: packing carry
symbols.meaning: The carry into block j when forming A_u, in {-1,0}.
symbols.quote: To form $A_u$, start with carry $\gamma_0=0$, let $d_j\in[0,B_0)$ be the residue of $u_j+\gamma_j$ modulo $B_0$, and put $\gamma_{j+1}=(u_j+\gamma_j-d_j)/B_0$.

symbols.name: packed block
symbols.meaning: The j-th block of 4p bits of the encoding of A_u, in [0,B_0).
symbols.quote: To form $A_u$, start with carry $\gamma_0=0$, let $d_j\in[0,B_0)$ be the residue of $u_j+\gamma_j$ modulo $B_0$, and put $\gamma_{j+1}=(u_j+\gamma_j-d_j)/B_0$.

symbols.name: product coefficient
symbols.meaning: The coefficient of y^j in an ordinary integer-polynomial product such as h=ac.
symbols.quote: For the ordinary product $h=ac$ in $\mathbb Z[y]$, $A_aA_c=(ac)(B_0)=\sum_{j<2r}h_jB_0^j$, padding $h_{2r-1}=0$.

symbols.name: product integer
symbols.meaning: One of the four product integers, equal to the sum of h_j B_0^j for its ordinary product h.
symbols.quote: Extraction takes one product integer $Z=\sum_{j<2r}h_jB_0^j$, where $h$ is its ordinary product.

symbols.name: block of Z
symbols.meaning: The j-th block of Z in sign-extended two's complement, in [0,B_0).
symbols.quote: Because $|Z|<B_0^{2r}/4$, write $Z=\sum_{j<2r}q_jB_0^j+\varepsilon B_0^{2r}$ with blocks $0\le q_j<B_0$ and $\varepsilon\in\{-1,0\}$.

symbols.name: sign extension
symbols.meaning: The sign-extension digit of Z, in {-1,0}.
symbols.quote: Because $|Z|<B_0^{2r}/4$, write $Z=\sum_{j<2r}q_jB_0^j+\varepsilon B_0^{2r}$ with blocks $0\le q_j<B_0$ and $\varepsilon\in\{-1,0\}$.

symbols.name: extraction carry
symbols.meaning: The carry into block j during extraction, in {0,1}.
symbols.quote: Put $\rho_0=0$ and let $\rho_j$ be the carry into block $j$.

symbols.name: extracted coefficient
symbols.meaning: The centered residue of q_j+rho_j modulo B_0, equal to h_j.
symbols.quote: At block $j$ let $\widehat h_j$ be the unique integer in $[-B_0/2,B_0/2)$ congruent to $q_j+\rho_j$ modulo $B_0$

symbols.name: numerator coefficient
symbols.meaning: The Gaussian integer coefficient of y^j after reduction modulo y^r+1.
symbols.quote: Let $H_j$ be the resulting Gaussian integer coefficient.

symbols.name: first-factor index
symbols.meaning: The index of a coefficient of the first factor.
symbols.quote: For each $j_1$, the index of a coefficient of the first factor, exactly one $j_2$, the index of a coefficient of the second factor, has $j_1+j_2\equiv j\pmod r$, signed $+$ if $j_1+j_2=j$ and $-$ otherwise.

symbols.name: second-factor index
symbols.meaning: The index of a coefficient of the second factor.
symbols.quote: For each $j_1$, the index of a coefficient of the first factor, exactly one $j_2$, the index of a coefficient of the second factor, has $j_1+j_2\equiv j\pmod r$, signed $+$ if $j_1+j_2=j$ and $-$ otherwise.
